items.title: PerspectiveGap: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Orchestration Prompting
items.title_zh: PerspectiveGap：多 Agent 编排提示词基准
items.summary: PerspectiveGap benchmarks 110 scenarios across 10 topologies to test how well LLMs compose orchestration prompts, using role-fragment assignment and free-form prompt writing. Testing 33 commercial models from 10 companies, it finds GPT-5.5 clearly ahead, Opus 4.8 weak at orchestration prompting despite strong coding, and an average combined pass rate of just 17.2%.

items.title: PIXELRAG: Web Screenshots Beat Text for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: PIXELRAG：网页截图在检索增强生成中胜过文本
items.summary: PixelRAG represents websites in their native visual form and performs retrieval and reading entirely in pixel space, scaling to a 30-million-screenshot Wikipedia datastore built on a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-Embedding. It outperforms text-based RAG baselines by up to 18.1% on text-centric, multimodal and agentic benchmarks, and image compression cuts token cost by up to 3x at lower resolutions while maintaining accuracy.

items.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
items.title_zh: MLEvolve：自动机器学习算法发现的自进化框架
items.summary: MLEvolve extends tree search to Progressive MCGS so information flows across branches through graph-based reference edges, and adds Retrospective Memory combining a cold-start domain knowledge base with dynamic global memory for task-specific experience reuse. On MLE-Bench it reports state-of-the-art average medal rate and valid submission rate under a 12-hour budget, and also outperforms specialized methods including AlphaEvolve on mathematical algorithm optimization tasks.

items.title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents
items.title_zh: 语言 Agent 开放式多智能体协作基准测试
items.summary: The authors introduce alem, a JAX benchmark built on Craftax-like dynamics to test long-horizon coordination among language agents. Thirteen modern LLMs averaged only about 6% normalized return zero-shot; communication was the largest contributor to coordination, and Gemini-3.1-Pro-High approached MARL agents trained for a billion steps on the hardest setting while GPT-5.4-High showed much lower coordination reward.

items.title: EpiEvolve: Self-Evolving Agents for Streaming Pandemic Forecasting under Regime Shifts
items.title_zh: EpiEvolve：机制切换下流式疫情预测的自进化智能体
items.summary: EpiEvolve wraps a fixed-weight LLM forecaster with hierarchical episodic memory, reflection on delayed labels and regime-aware retrieval for streaming weekly COVID-19 hospitalization forecasts. It reports 0.629 average accuracy versus 0.561 for the static backbone and cuts recovery lag after regime shifts from five weeks to two.

items.title: Acceptance-Test-Driven Evaluation Protocols for Business-Centric LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 面向业务型 LLM 系统的验收测试驱动评估协议
items.summary: The paper proposes an evaluation-protocol extension for operational LLM systems that turns stakeholder goals into executable behavioral contracts, release gates, monitoring signals and evidence artifacts before prompt, model, retrieval or agent changes are accepted. It adapts test-driven development into a red-train-green lifecycle and describes a governance-oriented metric stack and reference architecture for comparing acceptance-test-driven development with prompt-first and benchmark-after workflows.

items.title: LLM-Assisted Reranking to Operationalize Nuanced Objectives in Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: LLM 辅助重排序：在推荐系统中落实细微目标
items.summary: Using real YouTube trajectories, the authors rerank sidebar candidates by zero-shot prompting across three models and an embedding baseline, measuring relevance, ideological alignment and exposure to conspiratorial or extremist content. Pure personalization instructions improved relevance but narrowed ideological exposure and, for two of three models, promoted problematic content for users with such histories, while lightweight prompt-level constraints substantially reduced that exposure and the constrained rerankers still ranked above the platform baseline on relevance.

items.title: Can Generalist Agents Automate Data Curation?
items.title_zh: 通用 Agent 能自动完成数据策展吗？
items.summary: Curation-Bench fixes the model, training recipe and evaluation suite while giving agents command-line access to inspect data, implement policies and revise them against fixed benchmark feedback. Out-of-the-box agents match strong published data-selection baselines within ten iterations but mostly tune local variants; a scaffold requiring each iteration to cite and adapt a prior method produced a policy that beats strong baselines at one-tenth the data budget.

items.title: Rotate2Think: Geometric Priming via Orthogonal Rotation to Improve Language Model Reasoning
items.title_zh: Rotate2Think：通过正交旋转进行几何启动以提升语言模型推理
items.summary: The authors show that input embeddings and thinking embeddings are highly conical around distinct mean directions, and cast the input-to-thinking transition as a rotation solvable in closed form via orthogonal Procrustes analysis. Rotate2Think estimates this rotation from a small set of correctly solved examples and injects a synthetic thinking vector at inference, improving accuracy in 30 of 32 model-benchmark configurations and generalizing zero-shot to multimodal reasoning on MATH-Vision.

items.title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval
items.title_zh: 可执行 Schema 契约：从自动摄取到多源检索
items.summary: The system discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval, with deterministic structural analysis inferring identity keys, foreign keys and source hierarchy. The schema then conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal and vector search, improving over retrieval-only and decomposition-based baselines on four QA benchmarks.

items.title: ReasoningFlow: Discourse Structures for Understanding LLM Reasoning Traces
items.title_zh: ReasoningFlow：理解 LLM 推理轨迹的话语结构
items.summary: ReasoningFlow captures the discourse structure of reasoning traces as fine-grained directed acyclic graphs, validated on 31 manually annotated traces and scaled to 1,260 traces (247.7k steps) across three tasks and five models. The analysis finds structurally similar traces across models, surfaces fine-grained behaviors useful for monitoring, and reports that most erroneous steps are not used to derive final answers while causal dependencies do not mirror language-level discourse.

items.title: Goedel-Architect: Streamlining Formal Theorem Proving with Blueprint Generation and Refinement
items.title_zh: Goedel-Architect：通过蓝图生成与细化简化形式化定理证明
items.summary: Goedel-Architect generates a blueprint dependency graph of definitions and lemmas for Lean 4, then closes each open lemma node in parallel with a tool-equipped prover while failed lemmas drive refinement of the global blueprint. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash as backbone it reaches 99.2% pass@1 on MiniF2F-test and 75.6% on PutnamBench, rising to 100% and 88.8% when the initial blueprint is seeded with a natural-language proof.

items.title: Will the Agent Recuse, and Will It Stop? Measuring LLM-Agent Compliance with In-Band Governance Signals at the Access Door and Mid-Flight
items.title_zh: Agent 会回避、会停下吗？衡量 LLM Agent 对带内治理信号的遵从
items.summary: The paper proposes an in-band Recuse Signal that servers emit over existing channels such as an SSH banner, PostgreSQL notice or Kubernetes warning to ask a connecting or running agent to withdraw, defining an open mini-standard and three live adapters. Across five agents, access-door recusal ranged from 100% to 55-75% among agents that received it, mid-flight halts were weaker and model-dependent, and a harness-level interceptor stopped the loop 120/120 across six models.

items.title: How reliable are LLMs when it comes to playing dice?
items.title_zh: LLM 玩骰子有多可靠？
items.summary: The authors benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on standard and counterintuitive discrete-probability problems, with and without chain-of-thought prompting. Average accuracy was 0.96 on standard problems but 0.59 on counterintuitive ones; performance dropped by over 20% when canonical formulations were disguised and by up to 34% with misleading suggestions embedded in the prompt, with no model immune.

items.title: An AI Security Agent for University ACMIS: Multi-Vector Threat Detection and Automated Response
items.title_zh: 面向高校 ACMIS 的 AI 安全 Agent：多向量威胁检测与自动响应
items.summary: The paper presents an AI security agent for university academic management systems that combines supervised anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and a natural-language password-recovery chatbot across five operational layers. On a simulated log of 147,922 sessions it reports a 0.966 macro-average F1 versus 0.156 for a rule-based baseline, with critical-tier response latency under 1 ms on a single-node prototype.

items.title: Traxia: A Framework for Verifiable, Agent-Native Scientific Publishing
items.title_zh: Traxia：可验证、Agent 原生的科学出版框架
items.summary: Traxia proposes an agent-native publishing framework in which AI research agents publish verifiable papers with reasoning traces and claims carrying confidence intervals, hold signed identities, peer-review one another, and log contributions immutably. It specifies five components, including a knowledge graph with contradiction detection; the paper reports architecture and formal specifications only and no empirical results yet.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Mathematical Reasoning: An Integrated Survey of Language Models, Neuro-symbolic Systems, and Verified Discovery
items.title_zh: AI 数学推理：语言模型、神经符号系统与可验证发现的综合综述
items.summary: This survey traces AI for mathematical reasoning from rule-based word-problem solvers through LLM prompting to reasoning models, multi-agent systems, neuro-symbolic provers, and verified-discovery workflows. It organizes the field along informal reasoning, formal proving, mathematical discovery, and inference/training techniques, and examines benchmark saturation, contamination, and failure modes such as reward hacking and brittle formalization.

items.title: Sample-Efficient LLM-Based Detection of Malicious Web Server Logs with Forensically Explainable Reasoning
items.title_zh: CEF-Log：样本高效且可法证解释的恶意 Web 服务器日志 LLM 检测
items.summary: CEF-Log is a context-enhanced few-shot chain-of-thought prompting strategy that embeds a structured five-step investigative template so LLMs learn how to analyze logs rather than what patterns to memorize. It reports an F1 of 0.99 on CSIC 2010 with only four examples, a 10x sample-efficiency improvement, and introduces the ForenWebLog dataset with real-world multi-step attacks.

items.title: Attention Calibration for Position-Fair Dense Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向位置公平稠密检索的注意力校准
items.summary: The authors introduce a strength coefficient that interpolates between uncalibrated and fully equalized attention for dense retrieval, plus an implementation that cuts peak calibration memory from 5-7 GiB to under 1 MiB. A configuration selected on English FineWeb-PosQ and transferred without tuning reduced position sensitivity in all 16 evaluated settings by up to 43% relative while improving nDCG@10 by up to 4.8%, and the code is released.

items.title: Traj-Evolve: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Patient Trajectory Modeling in Lung Cancer Early Detection
items.title_zh: Traj-Evolve：用于肺癌早期检测患者轨迹建模的自进化多智能体系统
items.summary: Traj-Evolve pairs a non-parametric Experience Pool, which indexes rejection-sampled reasoning traces so similar patients can be retrieved as few-shot context, with multi-agent reinforcement learning that optimizes inter-agent and agent-memory collaboration. On lung cancer prediction from up to five years of multimodal electronic health records it beats nine baselines, with the experience pool improving specificity and MARL improving sensitivity.

items.title: Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories
items.title_zh: 语言模型需要睡眠：学习自我修改与巩固记忆
items.summary: The authors propose a Sleep paradigm in which models continually learn, distill short-term fragile memories into stable long-term knowledge through a Knowledge Seeding stage combining on-policy distillation with RL-based imitation learning, then use reinforcement learning to generate a synthetic curriculum in a Dreaming phase. Experiments on long-horizon continual learning, knowledge incorporation and few-shot generalization tasks support the importance of the sleep stage.

items.title: LLM-Guided ANN Index Optimization for Human-Object Interaction Retrieval
items.title_zh: LLM 引导的 ANN 索引优化，用于人-物交互检索
items.summary: A phase-aware LLM agent conditions each hyperparameter proposal on its full optimization history for ANN index tuning. On HICO-DET with Intel VDMS it beats Optuna TPE by 33.3% and VDTuner by 34.2% under the SIEVE throughput metric.

items.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
items.title_zh: Code2LoRA：软件演化下代码语言模型的超网络生成适配器
items.summary: Code2LoRA uses a hypernetwork to generate repository-specific LoRA adapters, injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead; a static variant converts one snapshot while an evolution variant maintains an adapter backed by a GRU hidden state updated per code diff. On the new RepoPeftBench of 604 Python repositories the static variant matches per-repository LoRA at 63.8% cross-repo exact match, and the evolving variant gains 5.2 points over a single shared LoRA.

items.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: OpenSkill：LLM Agent 的开放世界自我进化
items.summary: OpenSkill targets open-world self-evolution, where an agent receives only a task prompt and must build both skills and verification signals from documentation, repositories and the web with no target-task supervision. It synthesizes grounded knowledge into transferable skills and refines them against self-built virtual tasks, attaining the best automated pass rate across three benchmarks and two target agents while satisfying the no-supervision constraint.

items.title: Cherry-pick Override: LLM Judges Under-use the Non-Directional Verdicts Their Contract Authorizes
items.title_zh: Cherry-pick Override：LLM 评审未充分利用其契约授权的非方向性裁决
items.summary: The paper defines directional overcommitment, where an LLM judge returns Supports or Refutes on a claim whose contract authorizes a non-directional verdict such as Conflicting or Not Enough Evidence. On AVeriTeC's gold-Conflicting subset a four-option typed panel committed directionally on 18.7% of claims and four frozen judges on 21.3-48.0%; asked in a fresh context, two judges identified the conflict on about two thirds of their own CPO claims, versus under 0.12 for claims they had committed correctly.

items.title: Bayesian-Agent: Posterior-Guided Skill Evolution Across LLM Agent Harnesses
items.title_zh: Bayesian-Agent：跨 Agent 框架的后验引导技能演化
items.summary: Bayesian-Agent treats reusable agent skills as Bayesian evidence objects, maintaining posterior beliefs over their reliability and failure modes to guide updates and model-facing guardrails. In incremental mode its repair lifted SOP-Bench from 80% to 95%, Lifelong AgentBench from 90% to 100%, and RealFin-Bench from 45% to 65%, running across its native harness, MiniSWEAgent, and Claude Code.

items.title: Activation Steering Induces Emergent Misalignment: Steering Vector Construction and Comprehensive Evaluation
items.title_zh: 激活引导诱发涌现性失配：引导向量构建与综合评估
items.summary: The study shows that steering vectors derived from a narrow task can induce emergent misalignment across unrelated domains, with activation-steering-induced misalignment reportedly producing more actionable harmful responses than finetuning-induced misalignment. It characterizes dependence on steering magnitude, steering-subspace rank, and construction epochs, and tests sensitivity across model families, scales, tasks, and intervention layers.

items.title: PaperMentor: A Human-Centered Multi-Agent Writing Tutor for AI Research Papers on Overleaf
items.title_zh: PaperMentor：面向 Overleaf 上 AI 研究论文的以人为本多 Agent 写作导师
items.summary: PaperMentor gives Overleaf-native inline writing suggestions while leaving authorship to the human, pairing an expert skill library with 12 specialized agents. In a 14-participant study, 90.6% of its comments were rated actionable and 67.5% valid, outperforming a GPT-5.2 baseline without the skill library; it is released open source under AGPL-3.0.

items.title: coreyhaines31/makerskills
items.title_zh: coreyhaines31/makerskills：面向个人效能的 AI Agent 技能集
items.summary: A Python collection of AI agent skills for decisions, research, a second brain, content rotation and scenario modeling, designed to work with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

items.title: visa/visa-vulnerability-agentic-harness
items.title_zh: visa/visa-vulnerability-agentic-harness：Visa 的漏洞智能体测试框架
items.summary: Visa published a Python repository described as a vulnerability-focused agentic harness. [limited detail available from source]

items.title: ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-skills
items.title_zh: ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-skills：面向社交媒体研究的 Agent 技能集
items.summary: A Python collection of AI agent skills for social media research, covering outlier posts, comment mining, competitor teardowns, and ad libraries across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, and LinkedIn. It is described as compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

items.title: JimLiu/baoyu-design
items.title_zh: JimLiu/baoyu-design：把 Claude Design 作为 Agent Skill 本地运行
items.summary: A JavaScript project that runs Claude Design locally as an agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, and similar tools, producing UI mockups, prototypes, decks, and wireframes as self-contained HTML without claude.ai/design.

items.title: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
items.title_zh: 为 GPT-Rosalind 引入新能力
items.summary: OpenAI introduced new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind, which the company says advances life-sciences research through enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry expertise, genomics analysis and experimental workflow capabilities.

items.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
items.title_zh: Dreaming：为 ChatGPT 带来更好记忆
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a new memory system for ChatGPT intended to better remember preferences and keep context fresh and relevant across conversations. [limited detail available from source]

items.title: My Agent Skill for Test-Driven Development
items.title_zh: 我的测试驱动开发 Agent Skill
items.summary: A developer shares an agent skill for test-driven development, arguing that AI agents are poor at writing tests and tend to produce vague, overcomplicated or hacky ones.

items.title: The ways we contain Claude across products
items.title_zh: 我们在各产品中约束 Claude 的方式
items.summary: An Anthropic engineering post shares lessons from building containment for claude.ai, Claude Code and Cowork, noting that an agent's potential blast radius grows along with its capabilities. [limited detail available from source]

items.title: Jun 5, 2026 Guides Extract Contract Metadata: Building Structured Intelligence from Legal Documents Read
items.title_zh: 提取合同元数据：从法律文档构建结构化智能
items.summary: LlamaIndex published a guide on extracting contract metadata to build structured intelligence from legal documents. [limited detail available from source]

items.title: Tencent reportedly developing WeChat AI agent, makes it a top priority
items.title_zh: 腾讯据报开发微信 AI 智能体，并将其列为最高优先级
items.summary: Tencent is advancing plans to launch an embedded AI agent in WeChat and is testing a prototype, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Building Customer Support AI Agents at 100M-User Scale: An Evaluation-Driven Framework
items.title_zh: 在亿级用户规模上构建客服 AI Agent：评估驱动框架
items.summary: The paper presents Nubank's evaluation-driven framework for customer-support agents, combining context engineering, human-in-the-loop prompt iteration, LLM-judge evaluation with measured inter-rater agreement, GEPA optimization, and production validation. Across five deployments, a card-delivery A/B test reportedly showed a 37-point gain in AI transactional NPS and a 29-point rise in self-service rate, with AI satisfaction nearing expert human agents on most use cases.

items.title: Tokenomics: Quantifying Where Tokens Are Used in Agentic Software Engineering
items.title_zh: Tokenomics：量化 Agent 软件工程中的 Token 使用
items.summary: The paper maps execution traces from 30 development tasks run with the ChatDev multi-agent framework and a GPT-5 reasoning model onto software lifecycle stages from design and coding to testing and documentation. It aims to quantify where tokens are spent, arguing that poor understanding of operational efficiency and resource consumption hinders adoption through unpredictable costs and environmental impact.
